name: Gritz N Wafflez

Address: 3183 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 185, Los Angeles, CA 90010.
Hours: open daily, 9 AM to 3 PM.
The first 15 minutes of valet are complimentary.
GNW Karaoke is every Wednesday, 6 to 10 PM.
The app has a game called Order Up! that you can play while you wait.
Order Up! is free to play with no account needed.
You need a free member account only to save a score or claim a prize.

450 points = Free side of Smackin' Mac.
700 points = Free Original Collard Green Dip.
1,100 points = Free N' Wafflez plate.

Food prizes and discounts from the spin are good for 3 days at the Koreatown location, one reward per visit.
Weekly champion prize: Free Wingz N' Wafflez plus a karaoke shoutout.

Adult prizes: 13,500 = Free Kiki Palmer; 22,000 = Free side of Smackin' Mac; 32,000 = Free Fried Cheese Gritz; 46,500 = Free Original Collard Green Dip.

Prices are on the online order page, not in the app's menu list.
The app has a language menu (the globe button).
You can add the app to your phone's Home Screen.
Questions about rules: call (213) 566-4837.

qa.q: What is the free daily spin?
qa.a: Members get one free spin a day (Los Angeles time) and every slice wins something. It's never sold and costs nothing.

qa.q: What can I win on the daily spin?
qa.a: +50 points (30%), +100 points (20%), +75 points (15%), $2 off any plate (15%), Free Kiki Palmer (8%), Free side of Smackin' Mac (7%), or 10% off your order (5%).

qa.q: How long do spin prizes last?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at our Koreatown location, one reward per visit. They can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: Do I have to buy something to spin or play?
qa.a: No. No purchase is needed to spin, play Order Up! or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.
It's our game. You work the line, build each guest's plate, serve it hot and deliver it to the right table. Play it while you wait.

qa.q: How do I play Order Up!?
qa.a: Tap the food tiles to build the plate, tap Serve, then tap the hot plate on the pass and tap the guest's table.

qa.q: How do I take something off the plate?
qa.a: Tap the tile again or hit Undo. Undo costs you the clean-build bonus.

qa.q: Why does the food get cold?
qa.a: Plates cool on the pass: hot, warm, cooling, then cold. Cold food pays less and gets no tip, so deliver fast.
Speed is the big one (up to +190), then heat (up to +80), the order's pay, tips, +30 per correct item, +40 for a clean build, streaks up to x2 and bonuses for clearing levels.

qa.q: How do tips work in the game?
qa.a: Fast, hot, happy guests tip more. A perfect plate (no undo), hot and at the right table earns the big tip. Cold plates get no tip.

qa.q: What costs me points in the game?
qa.a: Wrong plate -20, adding a NO item -60, wrong table -15, undercooked -30, charred -15 and a walk-out -50.
A table that waited too long and left. Three walk-outs and the kitchen closes.
Each level is 90 seconds. Levels 1 to 3 are just tap and serve.
A cook leaves and you're on the fryer: catfish, wingz, tenderz and shrimp. Tap the tile, then tap the basket when it hits perfect.
The whole kitchen: waffle irons (pour, open on green) and the skillet for eggs, bacon and sauteed shrimp. Guests also add prep requests.
Perfect, fast plates in a row raise a multiplier, x1.2, x1.4 and up to x2. A wrong plate resets it.
Serve every plate at a table within 10 seconds of each other for +30 per guest.

qa.q: What is the poster on the wall?
qa.a: Tap Antidote's food review poster on the wall for +250 the first time each run. You can watch his review too.
Order Up! is free to play as often as you like, no account needed.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. You only need a free member account to save your score or claim a prize after a run.

qa.q: What prizes can I win in Order Up! Adult mode?
qa.a: One run over 13,500 = Free Kiki Palmer; 22,000 = Free side of Smackin' Mac (with any order); 32,000 = Free Fried Cheese Gritz (with any plate); 46,500 = Free Original Collard Green Dip.
No. Game prizes depend only on your score, not chance. It's a game of skill.

qa.q: How long do I have to use a game prize?
qa.a: You must use it within 3 days. You can hold one prize at a time.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins the weekly prize. Ties go to the score posted first, and the board resets every Monday.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: A Free Wingz N' Wafflez plus a karaoke shoutout. The champion is crowned at GNW Karaoke on Wednesday.
The top score at Sunday close wins, and the champion is crowned at Wednesday karaoke.

qa.q: Do Kid and Adult modes share a leaderboard?
qa.a: No. Each mode has its own prizes, scores to beat, best score and weekly board.
It's for ages 12 and under: slower timers, more patient guests and kid-sized prizes. A parent or guardian must sign in first.

qa.q: How do I turn on Kid mode?
qa.a: A parent or guardian signs in with their own name, phone and email and confirms they're the parent, then hands over the phone.
Scores of 9,500 = Free Fresh Squeezed OJ; 11,000 = Free side of French Friez; 12,750 = Free Sweet Gritz; 13,250 = Free Chocolate Chip Waffle.
Kid prizes are redeemed with the young player at the table, one per kid per visit. Codes start with KID- and show a KID PRIZE tag.

qa.q: How do I leave Kid mode?
qa.a: The app asks for the last 4 digits of the parent's phone number.
No data is collected from children. The account and contact info belong to the parent, and the child never enters anything.
Residents of the United States age 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission. Employees can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free account per person and per phone. Multiple accounts, cheats and bots are disqualified.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Tap the globe button to switch languages, including Spanish, Korean, Chinese, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Japanese and more. Restaurant and game names stay in English.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Use Add to Home Screen. On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add. On Android, use the menu and tap Install or Add to Home screen.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Pair a Bluetooth or USB controller, press any button, and it can tap through Order Up!.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Opt-in texts and emails can be stopped anytime by replying STOP.
Only if you opt in to deal texts. Reply STOP anytime to opt out.

qa.a: Yes, we're @gritznwafflez on Instagram, and recent posts show in the app.
